description: This is a PHP source file defining the SubscriptionStatus class within the Opencart.Admin.Model.Localisation namespace. The class provides methods for managing subscription status data, including adding, editing, deleting, and retrieving subscription status records and their descriptions in different languages.

classes.name: SubscriptionStatus
classes.description: A class that manages CRUD operations and retrieval of subscription statuses and their localized descriptions.

methods.name: addSubscriptionStatus
methods.description: Adds a new subscription status record for multiple languages based on provided data.

methods.name: editSubscriptionStatus
methods.description: Edits an existing subscription status by deleting the current one and re-adding descriptions.

methods.name: deleteSubscriptionStatus
methods.description: Deletes a subscription status record from the database.

methods.name: getSubscriptionStatus
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information for a specific subscription status.

methods.name: getSubscriptionStatuses
methods.description: Retrieves a list of subscription statuses, optionally ordered, sorted, and paginated.

methods.name: getTotalSubscriptionStatuses
methods.description: Returns the total count of subscription statuses for the current language.

methods.name: addDescription
methods.description: Adds a localized description for a specific subscription status and language.

methods.name: getDescriptions
methods.description: Retrieves all descriptions for a specific subscription status.

methods.name: getDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Retrieves descriptions for a specific language across all subscription statuses.
